title: Open-Cut Mine Equipment Relocation
fullBody:
## The Challenge

A major mining company needed to relocate its entire open-cut mining fleet from a depleted mine site in Rajasthan to a new greenfield operation in Madhya Pradesh — a distance of 1,200 kilometres through challenging terrain including a mountain range crossing.

The fleet included 14 large excavators (the largest weighing 580 tonnes), 22 haul trucks, 6 dozers, and assorted ancillary equipment. The total transport value exceeded US$180 million, and the client required all equipment on site within 60 days to meet the new mine's production ramp-up schedule.

## Planning and Preparation

SSVT's project logistics team conducted detailed route surveys over a three-week period, identifying the mountain crossing as the critical challenge. A 12-kilometre section required temporary road reinforcement to accommodate the heaviest loads, and three bridges required temporary strengthening works.

We coordinated with state transport authorities in both Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh, and the National Highway Authority of India, to obtain all necessary oversize permits and night-movement approvals. A convoy management system was established to coordinate simultaneous movements on multiple transport corridors.

## Execution

Mobilisation of 42 specialist heavy transport vehicles commenced on Day 1. The largest excavators were disassembled into their major components for transport and reassembled on site. Working in round-the-clock shifts with police escorts on the sensitive mountain section, the team maintained an average daily movement rate that exceeded the original plan.

## Results

All 42 pieces of equipment were delivered to the new mine site in 55 days — five days ahead of the client's programme. The efficient execution enabled the client to commence mining operations early, accelerating the project's revenue generation timeline.
outcome: All 42 pieces of heavy equipment delivered in 55 days — 5 days ahead of schedule. Zero damage to equipment during transport. Client commenced mining operations ahead of programme.
